newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Mixed result in Swedish T-bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Mixed result in Swedish T-bill auction.

text.p: Sweden's National Debt Office said on Wednesday that an auction of Treasury bills was oversubscribed in two maturities but undersubscribed and cut in one maturity.
The average accepted rate in an auction of three-month T-bills worth two billion crowns ($261.3 million) was 4.18 percent, the National Debt Office said.
The office received 26 bids worth 3.3 billion crowns of which it accepted 20 bids.
An auction of six-month paper worth three billion crowns had an average accepted rate of 4.23 percent.
The office received 36 bids worth 5.87 billion crowns of which it accepted 20.
The debt office said the average accepted rate in an auction of one year paper worth seven billion crowns was 4.35 percent.
However, it cut the issue to 3.64 billion crowns after receiving 61 bids worth a total of 5.81 billion crowns, of which it accepted 44.
